messages:
jess_support: Heads-up — customer reported wrong tool outputs being attached to their request when the app issues concurrent helper calls (search + math). They say sometimes the search result ends up marked as calculator output. :confused:

lynn_runtime: ugh. do we have a repro payload or logs? is this the function-calling path or our custom tools?

jess_support: It's function-calling via our tool shim. Minimal repro from customer attached below. They trigger two calls in parallel with identical `name` fields and no explicit call_id. Observed behavior: tool_result entries come back cross-linked.

jess_support: ```json
{
  "request_id": "req_94a2b",
  "tools": [
    { "name": "search_v2", "args": { "q": "pricing" } },
    { "name": "calculator_v1", "args": { "expr": "12*7" } }
  ]
}
```

omar_sre: can you paste the raw runtime logs around that request id? want to see timing and socket multiplexing. could be a race in response dispatch.

jess_support: pasted below — trimming stack but keeping envelope headers. note the two responses' arrival times are within ~20ms.

jess_support: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01.123Z] req=req_94a2b -> dispatch tool_call id=call_1 name=search_v2
[2026-03-15T09:12:01.125Z] req=req_94a2b -> dispatch tool_call id=call_2 name=calculator_v1
[2026-03-15T09:12:01.140Z] worker-A <- tool_result id=call_2 payload={"result":"84"}
[2026-03-15T09:12:01.142Z] worker-A <- tool_result id=call_1 payload={"top_hit":"pricing page"}
[2026-03-15T09:12:01.143Z] runtime -> assemble_response req=req_94a2b mapping: call_1 -> calculator_v1, call_2 -> search_v2  <-- WRONG
```

lynn_runtime: important detail: runtime currently maps tool_result -> tool by assuming the n-th incoming result corresponds to the n-th dispatched call when call ids are not globally unique. If two tools have ambiguous same short id or we strip wrapper ids, association can flip.

maya_qa: i can reproduce locally. small script that fires two concurrent tool calls without setting a `call_id` will show swapped mapping 60% of the time when latency gap <30ms. attaching repro script.

maya_qa: ```bash
# repro.sh - spawns two concurrent tool invocations against local shim
node repro.js --tool search_v2 --tool calculator_v1 --concurrency 2
```

maya_qa: quick mitigation: ensure callers provide unique `call_id` per tool call; runtime should also fall back to using explicit `call_id` from the envelope rather than ordinal position.

omar_sre: agreed. short-term hotfix: validate presence of `call_id` in tool_call envelope and reject if missing (400) so callers are forced to add one. medium-term: change dispatcher to key results by call_id header and keep an explicit per-request map.

lynn_runtime: plan: 1) patch runtime to prefer `tool_call.call_id` if present. 2) add strict schema enforcement in the router at the dispatch boundary (reject missing call_id). 3) add telemetry to count mismatches and capture request ids for postmortems. can we ship a fast patch to canary?

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/router-schema-check v2026.3.15-hotfix -> canary (region us-west-2). started at 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z. :rocket:

jess_support: I'll tell the customer the temporary mitigation (add call_id) and that we're pushing a canary hotfix. Please add repro/test matrix so we can confirm.

lynn_runtime: will add unit + e2e repro harness (maya, can you help with deterministic flakiness test?).

maya_qa: yep, i'll wire up CI job to run the repro under different latency skews. will attach results once green. :white_check_mark:

omar_sre: also recommend adding an invariant check that logs when assembled mapping doesn't align with call_id headers — immediate alert to support channel.

jess_support: created support ticket INC-2026-334 and linked request id req_94a2b + customer logs. CC'ing CS for the customer outreach.

lynn_runtime: follow-up: runtime change will also add `origin_call_id` field inside tool_result for extra safety. schema PR incoming.

jess_support: thanks all. keeping the customer updated. :thumbsup:
